name: Enterprise Messaging Groups — Database & Backend Foundation
honestAssessment: Additive schema, permission engine, send gates, join/invite/lock/restriction APIs, audit, rate limits, and unit tests implemented. SECRET is a new ConversationVisibility enum value (not mapped only to UNLISTED). Phase 22.2 routes preserved. No production migration apply and no Cloud Run deploy in this phase.

criteria.description: SECRET is additive enum value per approved architecture
Migration additive only; no DirectMessage/Conversation drop/rewrite
Join policies, join requests, invite maxUses/expiry/approval/preview
Announcement/read-only/locked modes, slow mode, temporary lockdown
Server-authoritative group send gates + UserBlock check
Unit tests for engine, visibility SECRET, wiring, 22.2 regression

rollbackPlan: Do not apply migration in prod until 29.7. If code is merged but unused, revert BE commit. If migration applied later, leave additive objects and roll BE revision.
risks: Join request @@unique(conversationId,userId,status) may need operational care for re-requests after REJECTED (allowed as different status)
Prisma client generate path may point at workspace package location — ensure CI runs prisma generate in geezle-backend
In-process rate limits are per-instance until Redis dual-write
